paper_title: Rethinking the Role of Prompting Strategies in LLM Test-Time Scaling A   Perspective of Probability Theory
caption: Results of combining adaptively scaling and dynamically choosing the optimal i on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on MATH.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The provided line chart illustrates the accuracy of several prompting strategies as a function of sampling time, ranging from 0 to 70. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," is measured in percentage points and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 4, spanning from 60 to 88. The horizontal axis, labeled "Sampling Time," is also linear and spans from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart displays seven distinct lines, each representing a different prompting strategy, as identified in the legend.

The line for "DiP" is purple with diamond markers and a solid line. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 58 at sampling time 0, rises to about 72 at sampling time 10, and then increases more gradually to approximately 76.5 at sampling time 70.

The line for "AnP" is orange with triangle markers and a solid line. It starts at approximately 68 at sampling time 0, increases to about 74 at sampling time 10, and then gradually declines to approximately 73.5 at sampling time 70.

The line for "CoT" is blue with triangle markers and a solid line. It begins at approximately 59 at sampling time 0, rises to about 72 at sampling time 10, and then increases to approximately 77.5 at sampling time 70.

The line for "Dynamic w/ Oracle" is black with square markers and a dashed line. It starts at approximately 84 at sampling time 0, remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations, and ends at approximately 84.5 at sampling time 70.

The line for "L2M" is cyan with triangle markers and a solid line. It begins at approximately 59 at sampling time 0, rises to about 72 at sampling time 10, and then increases to approximately 77.5 at sampling time 70.

The line for "Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle" is red with circular markers and a dashed line. It starts at approximately 86 at sampling time 0, remains nearly constant, and ends at approximately 88 at sampling time 70.

The line for "SBP" is beige with triangle markers and a solid line. It begins at approximately 66 at sampling time 0, rises to about 76 at sampling time 10, and then gradually declines to approximately 74.5 at sampling time 70.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the accuracy of various prompting strategies over sampling time on the MATH dataset using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, with the x-axis representing Sampling Time in units ranging from 0 to 70, marked at regular intervals of 10, and the y-axis representing Accuracy in percentage points, ranging from 60 to 88, marked at regular intervals of 4. The chart includes six distinct lines: a purple line with diamond markers representing DiP, an orange line with triangle markers representing AnP, a blue line with triangle markers representing CoT, a black dashed line with square markers representing Dynamic w/ Oracle, a cyan line with triangle markers representing L2M, and a red dotted line with circular markers representing Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle. The DiP line starts at an accuracy of 58.8% at sampling time 0 and rises to 76.8% by sampling time 70. The AnP line begins at 67.2% and ends at 74.0%. The CoT line starts at 60.0% and rises to 77.2%. The Dynamic w/ Oracle line begins at 85.2% and ends at 84.0%. The L2M line starts at 60.0% and rises to 77.6%. The Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle line begins at 85.2% and remains nearly constant at 88.0% across the entire sampling time range.
